name: app-lime-smart-home-tiles-cropped-phone
title: Cropped phone corner with lime humidity card and photographic room tiles
whatItIs: A close, cropped view of a phone's lower corner on a deep olive background. The screen shows a big lime rounded card '70% Humidity' with a white chip and a room photo tile labelled 'Office' with round icon buttons.
whatItMeans: Bold, tactile and modern; the lime device edge echoes the UI and the crop makes it feel like a detail shot.
techniques: Crop a device tightly so UI shapes become abstract graphics.
Match the phone's frame colour to the UI accent.
Use photographic room tiles with overlaid round controls.
Contrast a saturated lime card with a dark olive stage.

vocabulary.definition: A tightly cropped view of a device or screen.
A device coloured to match the UI's accent.
A card whose background is a photograph.
